name: Lost
overview: Scripture reveals that being lost signifies a state of separation from God, yet He promises His presence and strength to those who fear not (Isaiah 41:10). The Lord Jesus Christ came expressly to seek and save the lost, emphasizing God's active pursuit of those who have strayed (Luke 19:10). God's love is demonstrated in the gift of His Son, offering eternal life to all who believe, ensuring that the lost are not condemned to perish (John 3:16). Salvation is by grace through faith, a gift from God, underscoring that lost souls are restored not by their own efforts but through divine mercy (Ephesians 2:8).
